title: Austin: Phone Merger, Sewer Lines, Fines
summary:
*   **Traffic & Business Permitting:** A reckless driving fine was remitted, and permits were issued for electric signs at two locations and for several service car drivers.
*   **City Treasurer's Financial Error:** The City Council retroactively released the City Treasurer from a $200,000 bond liability, aiming to help him recover an $800 premium paid in error for a bond already cleared.
*   **Urban Infrastructure Expansion:** Two new sanitary sewer line extensions were authorized, costing approximately $450 in total, including one to serve the State Deaf & Dumb Institute.
*   **Major Telephone Consolidation:** Ross Larabee formally accepted the terms for the merger of the local United Telephone Company with the Southwestern Telegraph and Telephone Company, establishing a consolidated telephone franchise for Austin.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Whereas, on December 23rd
1915, Chester Thrasher ,as Treasurer of the City of Austin, executed to the City of Austin
his bond in the sum of two hundred thousand ($ 200,000.00) dollars, with the American
Surety Company as surety, said bond being required and given to secure the City of Austin
in the safe keeping and disbursement of monies received by said Treasurer from the sale of
Street, Sewer and other City bonds ; and Whereas, substantially all of said money has been
legally withdrawn and disbursed by the City of Austin prior to December 23rd 1915, and was
no longer in the custody of said Treasurer ,and he was no longer legally responsible
therefor: ad and Whereas, on December 23rd 1915, said Treasurer by mistake renewed said
bondin the sum of two hundred thousand ($ 200.000.00) dollars, with said American Surety
Company as surety thereon, and paid the premium for such renewal in the sum of Eight
hundred dollars($800.00); and Whereas, it is the desire of the City Council of the City of
Austin to assist said Treasurer to obtain repayment of the renewal payment so paid by him;
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas, that the said Chester
Thrasher as principal, and the American Surety Company as surety, be and each of them is
hereby released from all liability of every kind whatever to the

The following communication was filed in this office, on the 20th day of June
A D 1917, and is here recorded, viz:

Macon, Missouri, June 9, 1917.

To the City of Austin, Texas:

As provided in said ordinance , I hereby accept Section 34 of that certain telephone
merger ordinance adopted by a vote of the people of Austn on January 4th 1917, entitled as
follows: " An ordinance authorizing and providing for the consolidation of the local
Telephone Exchange at Austin, Texas, of Ross Larabee, same being generally known as the
Austin Exchange of the United Telephone Company, with the local Telephone Exchange of the
Southwestern Telegraph and Telephone Company, and for the purchase of the said property of
said Ross Larabee by the Southwestern Telegraph and Telephone Company , and fixing the
terms upon whichthe consent of the City of Austin to such purchaseand consolidation is
given and grannting to the Southwestern Telegraph and Telephone Company a franchise in the
City of Austin and repealing any prior rights and privileges, if any, of said Company and
also the franchise of the said Ross Larabee". (SGD) Respectfully Yours,
Ross Larabee.
